contentList.content: Taking a Critical Hit, you deal [1] in return and can knock the attacker Prone (Strength save vs Potency DC).

A foe who takes primarily[1] from you must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw or be stunned for [2] turn.

Difficulty Class is based on your Potency DC.
Targets of your throwing attacks additionally take [1] and fall Prone unless they succeed a Dexterity Saving Throw against your Potency DC.

While under the effect of Volatile Shield, your spells force the target to make a Wisdom Saving Throw or become Confused for [1] turn(s).

Difficulty Class is based on your Potency DC, but is not equal to it.
A foe who takes damage from your levelled spell must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against your Potency DC -[2] or receive Internal Burning for [1] turns.

When you deal[1], the target must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against your Potency DC or suffer Virulent Venom until the end of the turn.

Triggers no more than once per turn.

When a humanoid attacks you, they must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw or become your ally for [1] turns.

Difficulty Class scales with your Potency DC.
When you miss a foe, you spend one charge of Fear Essences and apply Fear for [1] turns, if a foe fails a Wisdom Saving Throw against your Potency DC.
When you score a critical hit with a Sneak Attack, all foes within [1] must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw against your Potency DC or be Frightened for [2] turns.
When dealing[1], you force foes to succeed a Wisdom Saving Throw against your Potency DC or be struck with Madness for [2] turn.

Taking any damage from you, target must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw or receive [1] charge of Curse of Aging. You have a [2]% chance to also receive [1] charge of this curse.

Difficulty Class based on your Potency DC.
Taking damage from this sickle, creature must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against your Potency DC or be inflicted with Immobilising Venom for [1] turns.

If you are an orc, half-orc, goblin, gnoll, bugbear, cambion, drider, hobgoblin, kuo-toa, Zariel tiefling, duergar, or Lolth drow, attacks with this flail force the target to succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw against your Potency DC or receive Tormenting Curse.
Upon becoming the target of your levelled spell, a foe must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw against your Potency DC or suffer a [1] charge of Curse of Weakness.

Dealing damage with the Stoker forces the target to make a Charisma Saving Throw against your Potency DC, or fall into uncontrollable laughter for [1] turns.

Triggers no more than once per turn.
Beasts damaged by this bow must succeed on a Wisdom Saving Throw against your Potency DC or become Frightened for [1] turn.

Call upon the ancestors, forcing the sky spirit to obey you, unleashing lightning power upon foes.

Difficulty Class is based on your Potency DC.

While in a <LSTag Type="Spell" Tooltip="Target_Darkness">Darkness Cloud</LSTag>, you inflict <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="WEAPON40_2">Curse of Weakness</LSTag> on targets damaged by you if they fail a <LSTag Tooltip="Wisdom">Wisdom</LSTag> <LSTag Tooltip="SavingThrow">Saving Throw</LSTag> against your <LSTag Type="Status" Tooltip="AMP_POTENCY_DC">Potency DC</LSTag>.
Spells or cantrips dealing[1] additionally deal [2] and force the target to succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw vs your Spell Save DC or be Frozen for [3] turn.
When attacking you with a ranged weapon, a foe must succeed on an Intelligence Saving Throw against your Potency DC or receive Aggressive Flash for [1] turns.
Undead that deal damage to you must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw vs your Potency DC or become inflicted with Celestial Flashes for [1] turns.
While under the effect of Mage Armour, shots from this bow force the target to succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw against your Potency DC or become Chilled for [1] turns.

Taking damage from this handaxe, target must succeed on a Constitution Saving Throw or receive Ice Grip until the end of its next turn.

Difficulty Class based on your Potency DC.
